{{Top|leg}}
'''Timour Lines''' was a major company based in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]]. They were known for the transport of fuel, and owned several fuel depots in the sector. When the terrorist group known as the [[Faceless]] attacked the mining company [[DynaCorp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], Timour Lines lost a major depot as well their freight transport contract.
